description: This file defines the API endpoints, request/response schemas, and related components for the DECT Voice Interface in a device management system. It includes operations to get and set DECT interface configurations, response schemas, and event definitions related to the DECT interface status.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Voice.DECT.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters of the DECT Voice Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Voice.DECT.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the DECT Voice Interface.
